q: How many trips are in the data?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM trips

q: How many green taxi trips were there?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM trips WHERE taxi_type = 'green'

q: What was the total revenue, the sum of total_amount, across all trips?
sql: SELECT round(sum(total_amount), 2) FROM trips

q: What is the average trip distance in miles?
sql: SELECT avg(trip_distance) FROM trips

q: How many taxi zones are in Queens?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM zones WHERE borough = 'Queens'

q: Which borough has the most taxi zones?
sql: SELECT borough FROM zones GROUP BY borough ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

q: What is the longest trip distance recorded?
sql: SELECT max(trip_distance) FROM trips

q: How many trips had more than 4 passengers?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM trips WHERE passenger_count > 4

q: What is the average number of passengers per trip?
sql: SELECT avg(passenger_count) FROM trips

q: How many trips had a trip distance of exactly zero?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM trips WHERE trip_distance = 0

q: What was the total of all airport fees collected?
sql: SELECT round(sum(airport_fee), 2) FROM trips

q: How many trips had a total amount over $100?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM trips WHERE total_amount > 100

q: What is the average fare amount for yellow taxis and for green taxis?
sql: SELECT taxi_type, avg(fare_amount) FROM trips GROUP BY taxi_type

q: What was the total congestion surcharge collected?
sql: SELECT round(sum(congestion_surcharge), 2) FROM trips

q: List each borough with its number of taxi zones.
sql: SELECT borough, count(*) FROM zones GROUP BY borough

q: How many trips were paid in cash?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM trips t JOIN payment_types p ON t.payment_type = p.payment_type WHERE p.description = 'Cash'

q: What are the top 5 pickup zones by number of trips? Give the zone names.
sql: SELECT z.zone FROM trips t JOIN zones z ON t.pickup_zone_id = z.zone_id GROUP BY z.zone ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 5

q: What are the top 5 dropoff zones by number of trips? Give the zone names.
sql: SELECT z.zone FROM trips t JOIN zones z ON t.dropoff_zone_id = z.zone_id GROUP BY z.zone ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 5

q: How many trips started in each pickup borough?
sql: SELECT z.borough, count(*) FROM trips t JOIN zones z ON t.pickup_zone_id = z.zone_id GROUP BY z.borough

q: Which hour of the day has the most pickups?
sql: SELECT extract(hour FROM pickup_at) FROM trips GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

q: How many trips were there on each day of the week?
sql: SELECT dayname(pickup_at), count(*) FROM trips GROUP BY 1

q: Which calendar date in January 2024 had the most trips?
sql: SELECT pickup_at::DATE FROM trips GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

q: What is the average tip per trip for trips paid by credit card?
sql: SELECT avg(t.tip_amount) FROM trips t JOIN payment_types p ON t.payment_type = p.payment_type WHERE p.description = 'Credit card'

q: What percentage of all trips were paid by credit card?
sql: SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.description = 'Credit card') / count(*) FROM trips t LEFT JOIN payment_types p ON t.payment_type = p.payment_type

q: How many trips started at JFK Airport?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM trips t JOIN zones z ON t.pickup_zone_id = z.zone_id WHERE z.zone = 'JFK Airport'

q: What is the total tip amount for each vendor? Use the vendor names.
sql: SELECT v.name, sum(t.tip_amount) FROM trips t JOIN vendors v ON t.vendor_id = v.vendor_id GROUP BY v.name

q: How many trips used the negotiated fare rate code?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM trips t JOIN rate_codes r ON t.rate_code_id = r.rate_code_id WHERE r.description = 'Negotiated fare'

q: What is the average fare amount for each rate code description?
sql: SELECT r.description, avg(t.fare_amount) FROM trips t JOIN rate_codes r ON t.rate_code_id = r.rate_code_id GROUP BY r.description

q: What is the average trip duration in minutes?
sql: SELECT avg(date_diff('minute', pickup_at, dropoff_at)) FROM trips

q: How many trips were recorded by each vendor? Use the vendor names.
sql: SELECT v.name, count(*) FROM trips t JOIN vendors v ON t.vendor_id = v.vendor_id GROUP BY v.name

q: How many distinct pickup zones did green taxis pick up from?
sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT pickup_zone_id) FROM trips WHERE taxi_type = 'green'

q: How many trips were dropped off at Newark Airport?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM trips t JOIN zones z ON t.dropoff_zone_id = z.zone_id WHERE z.zone = 'Newark Airport'

q: What was the total revenue (sum of total_amount) for each pickup borough?
sql: SELECT z.borough, sum(t.total_amount) FROM trips t JOIN zones z ON t.pickup_zone_id = z.zone_id GROUP BY z.borough

q: What percentage of trips had a tip greater than zero?
sql: SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE tip_amount > 0) / count(*) FROM trips

q: What are the top 3 pickup zones in the Bronx by number of trips? Give the zone names.
sql: SELECT z.zone FROM trips t JOIN zones z ON t.pickup_zone_id = z.zone_id WHERE z.borough = 'Bronx' GROUP BY z.zone ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 3

q: How many trips had a disputed payment?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM trips t JOIN payment_types p ON t.payment_type = p.payment_type WHERE p.description = 'Dispute'

q: Which service zone has the most pickups?
sql: SELECT z.service_zone FROM trips t JOIN zones z ON t.pickup_zone_id = z.zone_id GROUP BY z.service_zone ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

q: How many trips were there on each date from January 1 to January 7, 2024?
sql: SELECT pickup_at::DATE, count(*) FROM trips WHERE pickup_at < TIMESTAMP '2024-01-08' GROUP BY 1

q: What is the average total amount of trips from JFK Airport to any zone in Manhattan?
sql: SELECT avg(t.total_amount) FROM trips t JOIN zones pz ON t.pickup_zone_id = pz.zone_id JOIN zones dz ON t.dropoff_zone_id = dz.zone_id WHERE pz.zone = 'JFK Airport' AND dz.borough = 'Manhattan'

q: For trips picked up at LaGuardia Airport, what is the most common dropoff zone?
sql: SELECT dz.zone FROM trips t JOIN zones pz ON t.pickup_zone_id = pz.zone_id JOIN zones dz ON t.dropoff_zone_id = dz.zone_id WHERE pz.zone = 'LaGuardia Airport' GROUP BY dz.zone ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

q: How many trips went from a pickup in Manhattan to a dropoff in Brooklyn?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM trips t JOIN zones pz ON t.pickup_zone_id = pz.zone_id JOIN zones dz ON t.dropoff_zone_id = dz.zone_id WHERE pz.borough = 'Manhattan' AND dz.borough = 'Brooklyn'

q: Which 3 pickup boroughs have the highest average fare amount?
sql: SELECT z.borough FROM trips t JOIN zones z ON t.pickup_zone_id = z.zone_id GROUP BY z.borough ORDER BY avg(t.fare_amount) DESC LIMIT 3

q: Which hour of the day has the highest average tip per trip?
sql: SELECT extract(hour FROM pickup_at) FROM trips GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY avg(tip_amount) DESC LIMIT 1

q: For credit card trips with a fare above zero, what is the average tip as a percentage of the fare?
sql: SELECT avg(100.0 * t.tip_amount / t.fare_amount) FROM trips t JOIN payment_types p ON t.payment_type = p.payment_type WHERE p.description = 'Credit card' AND t.fare_amount > 0

q: How many trips did each taxi type make in each pickup borough?
sql: SELECT t.taxi_type, z.borough, count(*) FROM trips t JOIN zones z ON t.pickup_zone_id = z.zone_id GROUP BY 1, 2

q: What is the average fare amount on weekends (Saturday and Sunday) compared with weekdays?
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN dayname(pickup_at) IN ('Saturday', 'Sunday') THEN 'weekend' ELSE 'weekday' END, avg(fare_amount) FROM trips GROUP BY 1

q: What is the average total amount for trips with 1 passenger and for trips with 2 passengers?
sql: SELECT passenger_count, avg(total_amount) FROM trips WHERE passenger_count IN (1, 2) GROUP BY 1

q: What is the most common pickup zone and dropoff zone pair? Give both zone names.
sql: SELECT pz.zone, dz.zone FROM trips t JOIN zones pz ON t.pickup_zone_id = pz.zone_id JOIN zones dz ON t.dropoff_zone_id = dz.zone_id GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

q: How many trips were picked up between 7am and 9:59am?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM trips WHERE extract(hour FROM pickup_at) BETWEEN 7 AND 9

q: What is the average tolls amount on trips dropped off in the EWR borough?
sql: SELECT avg(t.tolls_amount) FROM trips t JOIN zones z ON t.dropoff_zone_id = z.zone_id WHERE z.borough = 'EWR'
